item.title: Mrs. Carolyn Jonell Hunt Batchelor
item.description: Mrs. Carolyn Jonell Hunt Batchelor, age 85, of LaGrange, passed away on January 28, 2026. Funeral services will be held on Saturday, January 31, 2026 at 1:00 pm at the Higgins Funeral Home at Hunter Allen Myhand Chapel with Pastor Tim Tidwell officiating. Interment to follow at Shadowlawn Cemetery. Family will receive friends on Saturday at the funeral home from 12:00-1:00 pm. Higgins Funeral Home at Hunter Allen Myhand, 706-884-5626.

item.title: Bradfield's buzzer-beater lifts Warriors to homecoming win over rival St. George's
item.description: Kayde Bradfield take a bow. Just seconds after missing a potential game-winning shot, the LaGrange Academy senior picked himself up off the mat and hit a layup at the buzzer to give the Warriors a 52-51 homecoming win over rival St. George’s. While Bradfield delivered in the clutch, it was a beautiful play design by coach Britt Gaylor.
